scope: Original 2017 WizKids base game, complete ten-page rulebook and all nine original species fronts plus Faderan reverse. Accepted original printed components and direct contemporaneous designer rulings included. Remastered, expansions and optional variants excluded.

independent_input_declaration.additional_inputs: Only actual manifest-listed original sources, accepted provenance files, their referenced component parent images, and two exact Turn 5 derivatives listed in crop provenance. Temporary page rasterization and pixel/hash checks are audit mechanics, never rules authority.

coverage_assessment.summary_section: Front matter, Overview, Components, Reading resources and cards
coverage_assessment.evidence: Booklet pp1–3 and 10: title/design credit, 4–9 players, 120 minutes, six turns, resource shapes/colors, nominal values, visible goods, hidden points, card symbols, supply and component counts.

Booklet pp3–5: species selection, printed starting quantities, star/library distinction, colonies/research setup, era order, actual-player-count tracks and Confluence selection, Kjas extra colony-track player only. Native sheets supply Faderan deck, Kt pairs, Im’dril fleet and Unity/Kjas entry setup.

Booklet pp6–9; native Confluence fronts/reverses including both Turn 6 reverses; direct designer article 26690049 establishes six Trades, six Economies with the sixth scoring-only, and five bidding phases. Final sharing follows final Economy, before scoring, without another Trade/bid.
Booklet p6: contingent/multilateral/future binding promises, compensation or per-item losses, loans vs permanent transfers, Trade ending criterion and Trade-only action timing.

coverage_assessment.summary_section: Inventing technology; violet converters and upgrades
coverage_assessment.evidence: Booklet pp2,6–7: one alternative input set, immediate inventor card, later sharing bonus, entry exception, two upgrade routes, named-card owner possession, spent cards and renamed identity. Borrower resource-paid upgrade statement follows the explicit two-card restriction on named-card spending.

Booklet p7: start-of-Economy colony support, optional once-per-turn economic converters, simultaneous production, no output chaining, donation area and next-Trade disposal, gifts cannot be refused. Booklet p9 and designer article 26690049 retain final donations and require correct input colors.

Booklet p8: per-invention current sharing bonus, Yengii bonus, shared cards, era-IV exception; announced ships, three piles, both bids committed, colonies first, full successful bid spent, pass retained, minimums, relevant-card-count/species tiebreak, limited binding bid negotiation and track cleanup.

Booklet p9 and native Final Confluence cards: half a point per octagon, pair of large cubes, or triple of small cubes/ships; groups remain separate, incomplete groups score nothing, highest total wins with no tiebreak. Precise Resource Scoring remains excluded.

Native sheet 01 front: fractional half colony bids, unchanged research bids, seedlings only starting/track colonies, doubled simultaneous economic uses, unchanged upgrades, token survival/transfer/removal and violet yellow/point output.
Native sheet 02 front: own interest converters prohibited including upgrades, same-color inputs/outputs, exact gray wilds pass through, no additional wilds, remainder single matching size/color.

coverage_assessment.summary_section: Faderan Conclave and all eight named reverse-sheet relic exceptions
coverage_assessment.evidence: Native sheet 03 front/reverse and accepted relic cards: Acknowledgment restrictions and mandatory return; one shared once-per-turn deck converter; Cache entry rounding and mandatory discount; Transport support and entry reward; Paradise climate/Trade use; Star’s Ruin Sharing Bonus; Gift first-transfer permanence; Grindstone preexisting-point input; Detector nontradeability and extra draw; Decomposer simultaneous ship-input restriction. Actual deck reverse shows four small white cubes plus ice/snowflake colony.

Native sheet 04 front: matching/combinable/divisible fleet support, sufficient fleet loans, no support needed for borrowed ordinary cards, entry point, starred fleet and lack of ordinary Colony Support; Transport exception on Faderan reverse.

Native sheet 05 front: split at normal bid opportunity, two near-equal later bids, no second split, recalculated colony-count ties; extra colony-track player only; territory tiles enter/flip during Trade, behave as cards, and may run both printed converters.

Native sheet 06 front: fixed paired converters, independent halves/upgrades and loans as one; nullspace entry/no other output/permanent trade/removal when consumed; unlimited colony support, automatic colony-tie priority, infinity final tiebreak.
Native sheet 07 front: same-sized gray substitutions, mixed wild inputs, no added gray from interest, theft immunity, flexible colony consumption, four computer worlds and one-colony support.
Native sheet 08 front: private invention, reduced Sharing Bonus, splayed retained invented cards excluded from research-team ties, permanent licenses in same Trade, no restoration of spent cards.

Native sheet 09 front: Envoys bundle/mandatory gift acceptance, stash trade but no gift, recipient nontransferability, end-of-turn stealing, exactly one target per converter, no double target, size/shape-only theft, envoy discounts without consumption, gray immunity, protection only for accepted trades. Direct designer article 26803262 confirms final theft immediately before score and actual input colors.

Consistent with full rules and species coverage above. Original sheet layouts and art corroborated against 2017 nine-sheet and 2019 Faderan photographs and native booklet tabletop art. Component values and phase counters independently read from their actual images.

author_checks.authority_used: Direct original author statements and explicit endorsement only. Other users, quoted assertions without endorsement, strategic advice, and optional closing house-rule suggestion excluded.
Direct original author statements and explicit endorsement only. Other users, quoted assertions without endorsement, strategic advice, and optional closing house-rule suggestion excluded.

provenance_assessment.pixel_lineage: All 15 listed component crop transformations recreated from actual parents and compared byte-for-byte in decoded RGB pixels: every comparison matched. Parent SHA-256, SHA-1 immutable asset URL IDs and dimensions also matched.
provenance_assessment.original_edition_corroboration: Confluence atlas fronts match booklet p4/p8 designs, reverse Turn 2 matches booklet p9; relic facsimiles and deck reverse match booklet p2 symbol/example and original sheet reverse exceptions. Species layouts/art/visible text match supplied original 2017/2019 photos and booklet tabletop images.
provenance_assessment.format_note: component-9-back.jpg contains PNG bytes, as manifest explicitly warns. Actual PIL format verified PNG; historical filename is not used to infer format. Its older provenance filename-correction wording is inaccurate but does not affect unchanged bytes or rules content.
provenance_assessment.display_note: Original view requested for each source image; tool/app reported display resizing on the 3024x4032 Faderan photo and 4096x2498 Confluence-back atlas. Complete actual source images were viewed, with exact source hashes recorded; all relevant component text was additionally read on native exact crops.
provenance_assessment.excluded_material: Unused component discovery candidates were hash/format checked as referenced provenance inputs but were not rules authority. Other users in raw designer threads, unendorsed quotations and optional house rules were excluded from conclusions.
